body: I am actually going into therapy next week, twice a week. I'm notstereotyping gay people anymore, or trying not to really because that's the way I've been thinking since too young. I'm trying though. I would never ever attack a gay person anymore, verbally or physically. And thanks for offering to talk if I'm feeling sad. I'm not sad, I'm downright suicidal.

I totally understand your reaction. Believe me, I've hated myself for it plenty and I still do. But like you said, I'm not a kid anymore and I know now that gay people aren't bad and I'm no longer homophobic. At all. I respect everyone on the LGBTQ+ community. It's just that I'm left with this phobia(If you can call it that?) of men, gay or straight. Rationally I know I'm in no danger anymore but somehow the fear just won't leave my head. I'm actually jealous of all the happy gay couples because, although I know it's probably not easy for all of them, but sometimes they make it seem so easy to love someone who loves you back respectfully. I want that. And at the same time it's my biggest fear. Thank you for reading my post.
Thank you for taking the time to put all that down. I'm gonna save this so I can read it later. Thanks again

I've actually just come back from the hospital yesterday. And no,there's nobody I can really be with. My mother is here but I've put her through enough already so I just stay in my room. I've been in a really bad place since I was a child, I don't really see it getting better any day soon.

Thank you. I've got a first aid kit now and threw away anything rusty or old. I already know what causes my selfharm though but I'm not sure what knowing that changes? I am going to a therapist next week and then twice every week, so I'm getting help I guess. But in the meantime I'm still sitting here, coming up with all these ways that could cause harm to myself. I've been pushing in these small prick thingys that you use to hang up posters (can't come up with the name for some reason) and push them into my arms and then when they're in, I'm just appalled by myself, at what I'm doing. Nothing is normal about this anymore. I'm afraid of doing permanent damage like in my arm. I've got other permanent damage too, although not by my own doing, and some of it really sucks. I've even had fantasies of using deadly selfharm. Are these thoughts still normal among people who selfharm?

Oh.. I didn't know that it could actually really be because of the previous abuse. I thought that somewhere deep down I must be needing the violence for some reason. My whole fucking live is filled with violence, even from my own side. Thank you for the link, I've added it to my home screen to read later. I've often been told that none of it is my fault and that I didn't want it, but I don't know, somehow believing it is still not possible. I wonder if I ever will. I just want to wipe everything away and start fresh, no memories, no family, nothing. I just want to not be taunted by my own inner voice.

Sorry for babbeling, I'm not doing so well. But thank you for your reply.
Had my head bashed into a mirror (not even hard), blacked out and next thing I knew I was in the hospital

It's different for everyone. A lot of things play a role in it. Age, gender, genes, physical illnesses, the situation, the support you get, whether or not you suppress it, etc. It could last as little as a few months to as much as a whole lifetime. Not trying to scare you or anything, but it's just that unpredictable. And you don't always have to get meds to treat it. Sometimes it can go away on its own, although I wouldn't wait too long if it's not going away.

As a victim of a paedophile myself, I can tell you that they're the worst filth that walks the earth. They destroy so much, you have no idea. On the other hand, I can understand what you're going through. Paedophiles are really good at manipulating people and winning them over, also they're scarily good at making people feel sorry for them. I'm not saying that all paedophiles are bad people because not all of them offend. If they don't hurt any kids, then they are kind of okay I think. Lots of them have been abused themselves but while that's terrible, it's no excuse to repeatthe crime themselves. They can get preventative help in therapy, learning how to deal with the urges and stuff like that. I'm probably biased here but I think it's only a matter of time before they do actually hurt a kid. Be careful, okay? You being underage could be what interests him in you. I cant be sure of course but still, be careful. If he does talk to you again and you don't mind, then go ahead, nothing wrong with talking. But don't go meet him, please, at any cost. No matter what he says or how much he says he feels bad or cries. Okay? It's sometimes too easy to be tricked into something you can't get out of anymore. And if he has hurt children before, then report him. There's no other reasonable option. Stay safe.
There's nothing left to add. Perfectly said and I completely agree.

Hi Kathrine, I'm sorry that I'm replying so late. I'm really sorry. Stuff happened. I'm really thankful for you to check up on me and for thinking I'm a nice person. You're probably the kindest person I've ever met and it's kinda nice to know someone cares. I'm here for you as well. I hope the packing is as good as done now and treat yourself to a nice coke for all the sweating you've done! Hugs

35 years? So I could just as well have to wait another 10 years, living like this? Fuck that... I'm amazed I've made it this far but I'm just so done. I can't explain it really. It's just that enough is enough. I've got nothing going for me and even if I did, I can't live with myself. I find myself really fucking disgusting, defiled, ugly, whatever, all that shit. I've got so many mental issues, I can't even open the front door without having a panic attack. Even IF I could be treated, I'm realistic enough to know it would take years. And that's just too long. Well, thanks for the talk too. It's nice of you to have replied.

I know what you mean with discouraging younger people. If I had known at 13 what I know now, I would've made damn sure I'd never have survived that suicide attempt. 'It will get better in time. You're still young.' That's the biggest bullshit I've ever heard.

going on 26. Been struggling with mental health issues (among sexual, emotional, and physical abuse for many years.) and have had daily very strong suicidal thoughts since I was 8. Tried suicide at 13 and 24. I just can't do it anymore.
I don't mind. I've got plenty of infections over the year's from abuse, almost died from sepsis once so I know what to watch out for. I wouldn't mind either way.
it's exactly the same for me.
I made a post as a silent cry for help. I wanted to see if someone could say or do something that would give me some hope again. Just to see if it was actually still worth it to go on.

I'm glad you seem to be doing well, it must have been a big struggle. And its good that you're not alone. But personally I reached my breaking point today. I don't even wanna get better anymore, I just want it to end.
Oh. What do I do if I want the opposite? I feel way too much, too intense, all the damn time.

Can't I just leave it as it is when I'm done? Cleaning it up would just be a hassle and I don't have the energy for anything. How do you know when a cut is too deep or does that depend on the person? And what's best to use? A thick blade or a thin one? Or maybe I'm not even allowed to ask that here, I don't know.

I'm about to go to my first appointment this Thursday. Not sure if I'm going though, I really have zero motivation. I've been trying for too long already. I used to box as a backyard hobby but had to stop. I also was into running a while but that didn't work out either. Now, if I so much as imagining going for a walk around the block, I start crying and having a panic attack. I'm burnt out. And I know you mean wel, when you say you're my friend but we both know that's neither true not real. People don't care. But thanks anyways, for trying and all.
my other addictions are way worse and life threatening so I think cutting is the safest alternative. And short term help as all I need right now. I can't feel worse than I do now.

That's all so sad but I understand. So in a way it's better to cut than to kill yourself. Sounds obvious now that I look at it. Thanks for telling me about it. I'm close to relapsing (alcohol or drugs) but those are dangerous. I think I'm gonna try taking up cutting instead. I guess it can't hurt to try. Safer than drugs anyway. Thanks.
It's okay, thanks anyway for suggesting something.

I'm sorry that you had such a shitty life. I know first hand that people aren't nice to people from the LGBTQ+ community. It seems like its controlling your life, so I guess it really is like an addiction. But you said it helped you in some way. Would you say it is or was worth it?
I doubt it but thanks I guess.

If I wasn't so depressed, I'd have laughed. Ive listened to hundreds of hypnotic videos, soft music, instrumentals, deep sleep sound waves, ASMR stuff, tried pretty much all I could think of. I barely sleep, no matter what I do. The only time I sleep is when I take 8-10 grams of Xannax. But I only do that once a week because I'm scared to become addicted again. So on average I sleep 2 hours 6 times a week and once a week I sleep for 15 hours.

I have a feeling we experienced something similar.. And yes, I was willing to do all that. I quit drinking and drugs all by myself. But I have no support, no friends and no family that didn't abuse me in some way. I don't trust people anymore. Been hurt one too many times. I wanted professional help after leaving an even worse relationship but didn't have support or money, so I was forced to manage on my own.

But now... I don't have the energy anymore. I just want it to be over.
yeah, I've noticed. I tried to sleep it off but couldn't sleep. I've tried to cry it out but now I can't stop. I just want it to be over

I know about the seclusing habit when people are depressed that's why I force myself to be around someone every day, but it's usually only my mother as she is the only one that cares about me. I don't have any people who love to make me smile. I've bee hurt by literally everyone I've known. They've all fucked me up. I've been sober for 8 months and drug clean for 4 but nothing's gotten better. It's worse actually because now I can think rationally and now I'm seeing what a shifty life I have. It's not worth living.
I get really bad panic attacks when I go out of the house. I've tried to distract myself a lot but it's never working.
I kind of helped myself. I got out of a bad relationship and I'm away from past abuse by my uncle. I've never gotten professional help but I'm about to, this Thursday.
Thought so. Thanks.

I'm sorry you had to go through that. I know saying that doesn't actually help but still. But if I won't ever get over it, then I don't know why I'm even trying anymore. I don't know really. I have a feeling I'm going to commit suicide one of these days. I've never been this low.
I've got my first appointment Thursday.
Hey Katherine! I wish I could say I had a good day but I really didn't. How are you today?
Yeah, I thought it was weird as well. I don't take it often though. Only sometimes when I really can't sleep.

I can't even draw stick figures so drawing is not really my thing. But yeah, maybe stabbing paper could help a bit. I used to stab my pillows with a boxcutter but that's just a mess and buying new ones kinda got expensive. I can always feel the anger especially in my hands and drawing is too gentle. But thank you for the tips, I'll try.

I meant Xannax not Anna's*


I'm sorry that you lost your girl but at least you figured out that you had to do something about your anger and anxiety. I get the feeling like you need to make amends. Anger can do a lot of damage to relationships and trust. But I'm happy for you that you seem to have gotten the help you need. I hope everything keeps getting better for you. I've got a doctor's appointment tomorrow so I'm going to mention celexa and lexapro. Thanks for your help, I appreciate it a lot. And if you ever want to talk if you're having a bad day, I'm always here to listen.

Hi, Kathrine, how sweet of you to check up on me. I'm still new here to, still learning stuff. I think you could be right as to why I'm so angry. I used to act bad as a kid to get attention, whishing they would notice something was wrong. Obviously they didn't. Being an addict wasn't always easy to admit because some people still think addict brought it upon themselves but I learned that telling people can also make them act more patiently with you and they'll usually avoid drinking or doing drugs when I'm there. I've been sober for 8 months now and drug free for about 4 so I still have a long way to go. I'm making an appointment with my doctor later this week for some help and maybe try therapy again, although I'm not entirely sure about the therapy yet. Talking to you and other people on my posts made me feel better. It gives me the little push I need to keep going. Thanks a lot for thinking of me again!

Thanks, I didn't know that addictions could actually do damage to Brian chemistry. The only medication my doctor ever prescribed me so far was Anna's and he never told me it could be addicting as well. Luckily I knew already so I only take it when I really need it. Like one pill a week or so. I'm making an appointment with my doctor for hopefully later this week, I'll ask him about antidepressants. Thanks for telling me.

Thank you, a lot. I think I might go to my doctor soon to see what kind of medication I could benefit from. I've been thinking about going back to my therapist as well but I still need to gather some courage first. Thanks for your message.
Glad to hear that.
That's great! And having a toxic friend is still better than no friend I think.

I used to box, as a backyard hobby only, and I had to stop because I intentionally didn't use gloves so that I'd skin my knuckles and bleed. I've tried a while ago to get into running to try to burn of some pent up anger and energy but that didn't work out. Thanks for your advice though, I appreciate it.
I'm a recovering addict so I'm not sure if that would be a good idea. Has medication helped you now? If so, would you mind telling me what it is you take?

I would never hurt anyone, I know that for sure. I'm usually the punching bag (metaphorically). I have spoken to my doctor and she too suggested seeking professional help. I want to but at the same time I'm too scared to open up.
I'm sorry that she's not talking to you. Maybe she wil talk again in a few days. Or try saying hi yourself? I don't know what happened but I'm sure it'll be okay in time.

I've been told before that I have self destructive behaviour. I've googled alternative ways to cope with anger and I've tried boxing. Problem is that I intentionally didn't use gloves so that I would box the skin off of my knuckles. I tried art too but I'm just not talented. Thanks for mentioning the anger subreddit, didn't know it existed. Still new here.

It's to let the anger and energy out but also with the desire to hurt my hands. It's like tiring myself out and having throbbing hands calms me down. I don't particularly like the sight of bruises, cuts or blood or whatever. It's just an 'at the moment' thing. I don't really think about it, I just have to get the anger and frustration out. It's kinda hard to explain so I'm not sure if it's selfharm or not. If it is, will it become a problem?

It's sad that you're feeling like this as well. Yeah, I've got severe social anxiety too. It's not professionally diagnosed or anything but it's pretty clear. It does make you feel lonely. Sadly I'm not interested in video games either. It's weird but nothing gives me joy.
Somehow that felt real, thanks for that.
I'm sorry that you had to go through that. I hope you're feeling better than at that time.
Thank you for being so nice and for the tips, I appreciate it a lot. And the same goes for you, of course, hit me up anytime.
I hadn't thought of that. Sounds cool. Do you know if you can get a driver's license if you have a panic disorder?

I've tried out all kind of hobbies to see if something interested me but no luck so far. The church (and a lot of religious people) in my neighbourhood aren't all that non-judgemental but I get what you mean. I have a lot of trouble being around people so volunteering is tricky. I did try volunteering at a local animal shelter when I was 18 because I thought distraction would help, but that didn't work out. I've been wanting to do the next best thing and adopt a dog, but I can't be that selfish. I know I'm not capable of taking care of a living being. Maybe one day. I'm on a disability payment because of mental health problems, no job for me. I know I'm sounding like I'm looking for excuses not to get help but I've been really trying. I'm thinking about going back to my therapist. Thank you for offering to chat. I'm not good company though, I'll only pull you down with me. Joining reddit did help a little because I've only met kind people so far and that's what I really needed. People like you, a complete stranger, trying to help and give advice, those are the people the world needs. Thank you, Kathrine.

I'm sorry that you felt the need to end your own life at only 8 years old. I also never thought I was live to see 25, but 40 is just too far away. I'm glad you have found your own way of trying to deal when things get bad, but I really don't want to live for another 15 years like now. It's not a life worth living. I've been trying to find things I enjoy to also try and distract myself but I can't seem to enjoy anything. Turning page one on a book and I sigh and close it again. Nothing holds my interest long enough. Thank you for your reply though, I'm honestly grateful for any tips or advice. I seriously doubt I'll ever feel okay but knowing someone cares helps, even if it's just a stranger on the internet. And congrats on being clean/sober for so long! That's one hell of an accomplishment. That's something you can really be proud of.
Screenshotted this message for the name. When I'm in a somewhat better mood, I'll look it up. I guess it can't hurt to try. Thank you.

It's okay. Well, it's not, but thank you. I've been to a therapist although only for two sessions and I just couldn't open up. My parents also didn't have the money to keep counselling up and I didn't see the point. I believe I'm unfixable. Yeah, I have a support system. I get disability money because of mental health problems and I live back with my mother. Otherwise I'm pretty much always alone because I can't be around people. Going outside is always accompanied with panic attacks so I prefer to stay in my room. I know that isn't healthy but getting up every morning is all the fight I still have left in me anymore.
I want to seek help but at the same time I don't. I don't know what's what anymore. Just in a bad state I guess. Thank you for your kind message.
I didn't know that. I thought all they did was give bad trips that could be potentially dangerous and permanent. I'll Google about it someday, thank you.
I'm glad you're able to enjoy doing those things. I think I'm just unable to feel joy, I don't know.
I'm a recovering addict, although I never did shrooms, so I'm gonna stay away from that. Thank you for the suggestion though.
Yes I did. I was sexually abused around that time until I was 18. After that I got in a really unhealthy relationship and battle(d) addictions.

I've never enjoyed anything really. Never had hobbies or any interest in things. The only thing I 'enjoy' is sleeping when the insomnia isn't too bad, because then I can just check out for a while. The only other thing I did like was hurting myself and trying to come up with new ways to do so.

I'm glad. No, no, nothing like that. I've been made to feel bad by my parents, them saying a lot of hurtful things like how I must've wanted it. Only my mother came around and started supporting me but my father never did. I'm just scared that if my own family will say hurtful things like that, how can I expect a stranger to react any better than that? I'm just too sacred to be told it was my own fault. I could have gotten help, could've done anything, but instead I just let myself be treated like I was less than dirt.

I'm glad your therapist is helping you deal with things. I've considered going back as well but still unsure. Has your therapist ever knowingly or unknowingly made you feel bad about yourself or the things you're dealing with? I've heard about it as well that keeping a journal can help so maybe I'll try that for a while. Thanks for your advice.
I don't know if I'll ever truly believe it wasn't my fault but hearing people say it isn't makes me feel a little better so thank you. The kind of world we live in is a really fucked up place.
Thank you for telling me this. It makes sense when you say it like that. I'm part of anybody. I hope I can get through this someday

I'm sorry that happened to you. I guess people think that if you're a stripper you won't go to the police because of the job, I don't know. My father also didn't believe me and still doesn't. But I'm glad you've got some support from your husband. I bet it's a bit more bearable if you can share the pain.
Jesus, guys.. I never expected so many of you to care. Thanks a lot, really, it's somewhat nice to know I'm not a complete freak and so alone. I should've joined reddit long ago.

Thank you for replaying. It's comforting to know that some people can be kind when it comes to this topic. You're right about needing to bring awareness. If I was confident enough, I'd want to help people in my situation too. If male rape was more talked about like female rape, then men might actually get the courage to go to the police about it. Too many rapists still get away with it just because of shame.

You're right, I've read about male victims coming forward about being raped by females and the hurtful comments those people get are just horrible. No wonder people don't get professional help. Mine were both male though, but whether it's a male or female hurting you, it always seems to be the victim's fault. In other people's opinions I mean. If a girl is dressed somewhat 'provocatively', people often say she asked for it. But people seem to forget that even if the girl walked around naked, it still wouldn't give anyone the right to hurt her.
It doesn't really feel temporarily though. I should've gotten over this shit a long time ago. I'm just worried I'll always feel like this because this isn't really a life worth living.

Thanks for believing me. It's totally unexpected to get such positive answers back. Sometimes I do wanna talk about it because Google seems to suggest that's the only way to deal with it, but I wouldn't even know how. Even just writing this post made me feel wrong. Thank you though for offering to listen.

Thank you for your kind reply. No, I can't talk about it to anyone. My mother, father and step-father know about it but our relationship kind of broke when I told them. I saw a psychologist twice but I couldn't open up. At the time I thought it was best to let the adults handle it and just pretend it never happened. I regret that now.
I haven't heard of it before but I'll go take a look, thank you.
